government.note: Federal presidential republic. The President is head of state and government, elected by plurality in a single round for one six-year term with no re-election. The bicameral Congress of the Union is elected separately. Popular consultations (2021) and a presidential recall vote (2022) were introduced under the 2019 reforms; they bind only with at least 40% turnout.

title.native: Presidente de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos

holders.note: Term shortened to end on 30 September 2024 by the 2014 political reform, which moved the inauguration to 1 October.
First woman to hold the office.

offices.note: 'to' is the handover date. Wikidata gives Zedillo's last day as 30 November 2000 and AMLO's as 30 September 2024. No acting presidents served in the period.

system.note: 300 single-member districts by plurality plus 200 seats by list PR in five regional constituencies. The PR threshold was 2% in 1997-2012 and 3% from 2014 (not modelled per year). seats_2000 is the result of the 6 July 1997 election (PRI 239, PRD 125, PAN 121, PVEM 8, PT 7); later changes of group before 1 January 2000 are not tracked. Consecutive re-election of deputies has been allowed since 2021.

chambers.review_note: seats_2000 uses the 1997 election result; check the parliamentary group sizes of the LVII Legislature on 1 January 2000. Also confirm the 2% PR threshold for 1997-2012.

system.note: Since 2000 all 128 seats are elected together every six years: three per state (two for the leading list, one for the first minority) and 32 by national list PR. In 1997 only the 32 national PR seats were contested. seats_2000 is the composition after the 1997 election per the Wikipedia infobox (PRI 76, PAN 33, PRD 14, PVEM 1, PT 1, independents 3).

start_2000.ideology_support_note: Derived from the 1997 Chamber of Deputies vote shares: PRI 39.09% (big tent), PAN 26.64% (christian democrat), PRD 25.69% (social democrat), PVEM 3.81% (green), PT 2.58% (democratic socialist). The remaining ~2.2% for minor parties is split evenly between left_populist and christian_conservative as an approximation.
